details:
In some worlds, especially foggy ones, it's near-impossible to make out avatar culling diamonds. You'll think an area is clear, go over there, and nope, people. Same thing with diamonds on the other side of a large room or a dance floor. (Yes, nameplates still exist, but most enthusiast users leave those off for increased immersion, especially since doing so unironically increases game performance slightly.)

I remember there was an update once that switched all the diamonds to opaque, and I actually liked that update cause it solved my problem, but everyone else hated it (which is totally fair cause now you can't see through all these diamonds), so it got reverted. Why not both, though?

Why not have an opacity slider that lets individuals adjust diamond transparency themselves? They could keep them as-is, make them fully opaque, or somewhere in between, their choice. It'd be a local per-client setting and wouldn't affect anyone else.

Thanks for your consideration!
title: Add opacity slider to avatar culling system
